$Comment: The restless graveyard's endless run, a Variant of ziggfreed-common's Zc_Encounter_Endless (its comment
tells the whole flow): waves of the restless dead that never run out, the Voidtaken Horseman every fifth
wave, and a breather between waves. It stands in the restless graveyard's prefab
(Prefabs/SeasonsOfOrbis/Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Graveyard.prefab.json, written by
tools/arena_markers.py) on the road south of the plaza, facing north toward it. The dungeon's Run.Endless
(ZiggfreedCommon/Dungeons/Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Graveyard.json) says which slot raises each wave, how
much tougher each wave is and what each cleared wave banks; this file says what each slot raises.
The four band slots, each two waves in a row before the next takes its turn, every row measured from this
script's entity toward the plaza: Band1, the bones, skeleton fighters with skeleton archers behind them;
Band2, the rotten, zombies with aberrant zombies behind them; Band3, the void, void crawlers with void
eyes over them; Band4, the restless, skeleton knights with skeleton mages behind them. Each near row is
three across 90 degrees 6 to 8 blocks out (the plaza south of the fountain), each far row two across 37
degrees 18 to 20 blocks out (the fountain's north corners): the Horseman's hard ride raises its waves at
7 and 19 blocks on the same bearings, and these ranges spread a block either side of them. Once every
band has had its turn the waves come again one size bigger, the band's rows rising two and then three
times at once, and the distance ranges spread a bigger size out instead of stacking it. A spot that is
not open floor is skipped, so a wave whose spots are partly blocked comes out smaller; check the rows
in the graveyard after moving them.
BossWave is Macro_Seasons_Of_Orbis_Voidtaken_Rise: the Voidtaken Horseman rides out of his marker on
the plaza's north side with his name on the boss bar, and a banner tells the party. Each return he is
tougher by the dungeon's Ramp, and the bands' creatures by every wave.
Groups holds everything the slots raise: the game's Undead (its skeletons and zombies) and Void groups and
the Voidtaken's own. Range 70 counts a creature anywhere in the graveyard and its entrance room as
standing, so a wave is never beaten while one of it chases a player toward the way out. PlayerRange 61 is
the Horseman's fight's own reach: a player anywhere in the graveyard starts the run and sees its bar, and
nobody in the entrance room. Delay 8 lets the arrival's intro camera end before the first wave, and
Breather 15 is the time a party has to walk out with its chest. The binding row
ZiggfreedCommon/Encounters/Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Graveyard_Encounter.json names the run, without
which nothing rises. This file's name is not a role's: a script named after a role replaces it.
